name: Park Hyatt Suzhou
positioning: Contemporary take on a traditional Suzhou manor in Suzhou Industrial Park, with rooms looking over Jinji Lake, the city or the hotel gardens
best_for: Travelers who want a Jinji Lake base with Suzhou-inspired design
Food lovers interested in Chinese dining with open kitchens
Couples planning a wedding or celebration by Jinji Lake

facts.text: The hotel is at 69 Xizhou Road in Suzhou Industrial Park.
The rooms have Asian-inspired details, including brush-ink printed screens and crabapple-shaped mirrors.
Standard rooms have a semi-private 'pavilion' with living and dining or study areas.
Lake view rooms look out over Jinji Lake and have a marble bathroom with a deep-soaking tub and rainforest shower.
Rooms have Le Labo bath amenities.
The Presidential Suite includes a karaoke room and personalized butler service.
The Living Room serves light snacks, afternoon tea and premium drinks throughout the day.
Xizhou Hall specializes in locally-inspired Chinese and international fare.
The Spa is on B1 and uses Eastern and Western healing techniques.
The hotel has a pool and a fitness center.
Wedding venues include a ballroom and the Jinji Room, with photo opportunities in the hotel gardens and around Jinji Lake.
The Humble Administrator's Garden is 8.19 kilometers from the hotel.

highlights.text: Xizhou Hall, the hotel's Chinese restaurant, is designed as a 'Theater of Food' with open kitchens.
The hotel is a contemporary version of a traditional Suzhou manor.
The Living Room is a modern interpretation of the traditional Ladies' Court, with three distinctively designed spaces.
The rooms use a blue-green palette inspired by the colors of Lake Tai.
Garden view rooms look out over Japanese pine and a koi fishpond.

considerations.text: Shanghai Hongqiao International Airport is 75.8 kilometers from the hotel.
The hotel recommends international guests use local mapping apps such as Gaode Map or Baidu Map.
WhataHotel notes limited entertainment options within walking distance.
